NOT A GATE -- two diagnostics added after the run, because two of the numbers above
cannot be read without them.
(a) SHORTLIST RECALL. The 2-step shortlist contains at least one true non-currency
product in 263 of 500 held-out reactions = 52.6%.
Every AUC above is CONDITIONAL on that. Loop 160 reported 0.8158 as the
shortlist's headline without this number beside it; the honest statement is that
the shortlist ranks well when it contains the answer and cannot find it at all
the other 47.4% of the time. That is a correction to loop 160's report.
(b) WHY THE FUSION DOES NOT HELP. Mean Spearman between the walk's ranking and the
balance ranking, over the same candidates: +0.0574. Two scores that rank the
same candidates the same way cannot add information by being averaged.

S4 the coefficients change nothing: -0.0039 against a 3-sem bar of 0.0575. Weighting a transition by how many molecules the reaction consumes does not change which species the walk reaches -- the stoichiometry is real chemistry the RANDOM WALK cannot use, not chemistry that is absent.
S4 FAIL

S5 balance alone scores 0.7029 against degree 0.6904, margin +0.0125, and does not clear the bar. Mass balance constrains WHAT a product can be but does not single it out: many species share an elemental composition.
S5 FAIL

S6 the equal-weight fusion does not beat the walk: 0.8053 against 0.8158. NOT because the two agree -- the Spearman between their rankings is +0.0574, which is almost independent. An unweighted rank sum of a 0.8158 predictor and a 0.7029 predictor gives the weak one half the vote, and that is a property of the FUSION RULE, not evidence about whether the signals are separable. The split-half test below decides that question, because this gate could not.
S6 FAIL
NOT A GATE -- does a FITTED weight change the answer? The weight is fitted on one
half of the cases and scored on the other, both ways round, so no case contributes
to both choosing the weight and testing it.
fold 1: best weight on balance 0.10 -> held-out fused 0.8262 vs walk alone 0.8275... walk 0.8275, delta -0.0013 on 132 cases
fold 2: best weight on balance 0.00 -> held-out fused 0.8040 vs walk alone 0.8040... walk 0.8040, delta +0.0000 on 131 cases

even with the weight fitted honestly on held-out halves, balance adds -0.0007. The chemistry is nearly independent of the connectivity and still does not add to it, which is a stronger negative than S6 alone could give.
S7 WHAT THIS STILL CANNOT SHOW
Balance is necessary, not sufficient: a balanced equation can be thermodynamically
impossible and have no enzyme in any genome.
1,115 species carry a generic R/X group and drop out of every
balance check, so lipid and glycan chemistry is systematically under-tested here.
The currency products are GRANTED in S5's main number. The un-granted variant is
reported beside it and is the honest figure for a gap where nothing is known.
Held-out reactions are ones Human-GEM already contains: this is recovery, not
discovery, and loop 160's R7 said the same thing about the same protocol.
